title: Mega Structures in the Lunar Interior:An Exposition on the Topology and Sizes of the Mega Cubes Embedded in the Lunar Interior
content: ABSTRACTThis paper examined the arrangement of geometric patterns in five different crop circle formations. This study is based on two assumptions. One assumption is that crop circle formations on farmers’ fields during summer months, especially in the UK, are created by plasma vortex ejections from the Moon. The second assumption is that the intricate geometric patterns in crop circle formations are three dimensional structural topologies embedded in one another by advanced ancient intelligent beings and that crop circle formations depict the interior of the Moon. The dimensions of the structures in the interior of the Moon based on these propositions were calculated from selected crop circle formations given that the Moon has a circumference of 10,917 km and a diameter of 276 km. The topology of various complex and geometric building architectures in the interior of the Moon were analysed from four crop circle formation patterns. The sizes of the various embedded structural topologies were calculated from a fifth crop circle formation that showed the complete geometric configurations of the lunar interior. This study showed that the Moon has a solid crust of terrestrial mineral elements while the interior is made up of complex regular geometric forms that encompass four of the five regular geometric solids; dodecahedron, octahedron, hexahedron and tetrahedron. This study rejects the notion that the Earth and the Moon has similar geology, history, origin and interior layers. This study underscores the need for more interdisciplinary research in strategic areas such as lunar exploration and highlights the imperative of revising the objectives of the race to the Moon by various national space agencies and private companies. This study also underscores the need to for more studies on the origin of our lone moon in order to better understand what future it portends for humanity based on the grand design of its interior.
